description: Estimate the fuel cost of a journey from the distance in miles, the car's fuel economy in miles per gallon (UK gallon) and the pump price in pence per litre. Optionally double it for a return trip and split between passengers. Returns total cost, litres used and cost per person. Costs in GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/fuel-cost-calculator/

mpg.description: Fuel economy in miles per UK gallon

pencePerLitre.description: Pump price in pence per litre

people.description: Number of people to split the cost between (default 1)

returnTrip.description: Double the distance for a return journey (default false)
